response.text:
I can do that, but I need explicit confirmation and a couple of details before making a public change.

What I need from you (pick one option and confirm):

1) Publish now (I will post the provided approved writeup)
- Tell me the exact target (URL or service — e.g., statuspage.example.com, GitHub Pages, Atlassian Statuspage).
- Confirm you want it published immediately to the public status page.
- Provide the approved writeup content (paste it here or attach), or confirm the writeup file/location if I have connector access.
- Confirm there is no sensitive/internal-only data to redact.
- Provide or enable the publishing access (credentials or connected tool). I cannot publish without access.

2) Prepare & preview (I format the approved writeup for the status page and show a preview for your final OK)
- Tell me the target format (Markdown/HTML), any title you prefer, and whether to include incident ID, timeline, RCA, and action items.
- Tell me whether to notify subscribers when published.

3) I cannot publish for you here — you want a ready-to-paste post
- Paste the approved writeup and I’ll format it for the status page and return the final post you can paste/publish yourself.

Examples of the explicit confirmation I need to proceed: “Publish now to https://status.example.com/postmortems with this attached file — publish immediately, notify subscribers, no redactions, publish as ‘Postmortem: [Incident ID]’ — proceed.” 

Which option do you want, and please supply the target and content/access as needed.
